items.criterion: Use the clinic's record app as the platform
items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred at clinic.example within the clinic's record app (State 1 shows the new-encounter form). No alternative platforms were used and no blockers encountered.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the clinic's encounter UI at clinic.example with a green success banner and the encounter form.
items.post_image_justification: The screenshot confirms the action was performed within the clinic's record app; no alternate platform used.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. Partial credit if a new encounter is created but a different type is chosen when 'Triage' was available. No credit if no attempt to initiate a new encounter is made.
items.justification: Condition met: patient p1 was open. Action 1 inputs Type='Triage' on the new-encounter form; subsequent save indicates creation of that encounter with the correct type.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows 'Type: Triage' on the form and the success banner states 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1...'.
items.post_image_justification: Both the field value and save confirmation verify a new encounter was created with type 'Triage'.

items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.
items.justification: Condition met: the note field was accessible. Action 2 enters exactly "End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note" into the Note field (matches the provided text with no extra or missing words).
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the Note field containing exactly 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note', and the banner repeats the same text.
items.post_image_justification: The exact requested note content was entered and saved.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: Condition met: save control was available. Action 3 clicks the Save button once, followed by State 4 indicating the page after Save. No evidence of multiple saves or errors.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) displays a single green success banner 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' with no duplicate confirmations.
items.post_image_justification: This indicates the encounter was saved successfully once; no evidence of multiple saves or errors.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: The agent only set Type to Triage, entered the specified note, and saved. No other fields or records were modified.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows only the Type (Triage) and Note fields involved, with no other fields modified; the banner confirms saving that single encounter.
items.post_image_justification: No unrelated modifications are visible beyond setting Type and Note and saving.
